channel.title: James Gartshore
channel.description: Free, friendly tech tips and poster design for Bridlington and the East Riding

item.title: Aged 40 to 74? Get your free NHS Health Check
item.description: For International Men’s Day this week, a reminder about a free check that’s for everyone aged 40 to 74 in England.

item.title: Fake Ads and Shops
item.description: With Black Friday and Christmas shopping coming up, I wanted to share a warning about fake adverts and online shops.

item.title: Stop Annoying App Alerts
item.description: Is a shop or game app beeping at you all day? You can switch its alerts off without deleting the app.

item.title: Looking after someone? Free help for carers
item.description: It’s Carers Rights Day. If you help a family member or friend who couldn’t manage without you, you’re a carer, even if you’ve never called yourself one.

item.title: Live Captions
item.description: If you're hard of hearing, your phone can show subtitles for videos, voice messages and even phone calls. It's called Live Caption.

item.title: Find a public toilet near you, on your phone
item.description: It’s World Toilet Day, so here’s a handy free website for days out.

item.title: Phone Magnifying Glass
item.description: Left your glasses in the other room? Your phone's camera makes a great magnifying glass for tiny print on medicine boxes, menus and bills.

item.title: Power cut? Call 105
item.description: With winter here, it’s worth knowing this number before you need it.

item.title: Stop. Think. Check. Then act.
item.description: It’s International Fraud Awareness Week. Scammers rely on rushing you, so a few seconds of thinking is your best protection.

item.title: Anti-Bullying Week
item.description: It's Anti-Bullying Week, and this year's theme is "Break the Silence". If a child or grandchild is being bullied online, here's how you can help.

item.title: Stop Autocorrect
item.description: Does your phone keep changing the words you type? That's autocorrect, and you can turn it off.

item.title: App Network Limits
item.description: When I'm out and about, I choose which apps on my phone can use mobile data. Mobile data uses more battery than Wi-Fi, and some apps quietly use your...

item.title: Find Your Own Phone Number
item.description: Forgotten your own mobile number? It happens to everyone! Your phone can tell you.

item.title: Let your phone help you drive safely
item.description: It’s Road Safety Week, so here’s how to let your phone help you drive safely.

item.title: Save a New Contact
item.description: If someone new rings you, save their name in your phone. Then next time, you'll see who it is before you answer.

item.title: Calls keep dropping indoors? Use Wi-Fi calling
item.description: Does your mobile signal drop out indoors? Wi-Fi calling lets your phone make and take calls over your home Wi-Fi instead.

item.title: World Diabetes Day
item.description: It's World Diabetes Day. Whether you have diabetes or want to lower your risk, these free tools can help.

item.title: Giving to Children in Need? Give safely
item.description: BBC Children in Need is on BBC One tonight from 7pm. Big appeals like this sometimes attract fake donation links, so here’s how to give safely.

item.title: Phone Torch
item.description: With the darker evenings, here's a reminder that every smartphone has a torch built in. Handy for finding the keyhole or reading a menu.

item.title: World Kindness Day
item.description: It's World Kindness Day today. A little kindness with tech can mean a lot to someone who's struggling, or who's on their own.

item.title: Location Permissions
item.description: Did you know some apps can see where you are all the time, even when you're not using them? It only takes a few taps to check.

item.title: Winter Fuel Payment Texts
item.description: Winter Fuel Payments start going out from mid-November, and scam texts about them are going round again.

item.title: Talk Instead of Typing
item.description: If the keyboard on your phone is fiddly, you can talk to it instead and it writes your message for you.

item.title: Remember a relative who served
item.description: Today is Armistice Day. If you’d like to find out more about a relative who died in the First or Second World War, there’s a free website that can help.

item.title: Do You Need a New Phone
item.description: Has a phone shop told you it's time to upgrade to the latest model? Before you spend hundreds of pounds, it's worth knowing that shop staff are often...

item.title: Medication Reminder
item.description: Here's a simple way to make sure you never forget your tablets. Your phone's alarm can go off at the same time every day, with its own name.

item.title: Block a Nuisance Caller
item.description: Is the same number ringing you again and again? You can block it, and your phone won't ring for them any more.

item.title: Phone Antivirus
item.description: I wanted to share something that catches a lot of people out.

item.title: Scam Texts
item.description: I wanted to share a warning about the scam texts going round at the moment, as there seem to be more than ever this autumn.

item.title: iPhone Coloured Dots
